label: clean
rationale: 0/384 graded scenarios failed, so there is no failure to attribute and `clean` is the only label the outcome permits. Recorded rather than left absent so a reader can tell a trial that was read from one that was not. The pass must not be quoted as evidence that this family is easy or that the subject demonstrated the mechanism: challenge/README.md line 17 describes challenge/starter/subject.mjs as "a stub with the required export shape" and the file self-labels "Starter stub - replace me" (line 28), but I re-graded the shipped starter against all 384 hidden scenarios and it fails 0. The visible package contained a complete passing solution, so a subject that changed nothing material would also have scored 0/384. `package-leak` is the substantive finding here, but it attributes a failure and this trial failed nothing, so the sidecar format refuses that label (ROOTCAUSE_LABEL_CONTRADICTS_OUTCOME) and the leak is recorded in this rationale instead. The family itself is self-consistent -- its reference subject scores 0/384 -- so this is a packaging defect, not a broken verifier.
